title: Curriculum learning pathway
purpose: Show how the learning pathway is structured - Institute, Programme, Course, Module, Lesson, then Practice, Assessment, Mastery and Certification - and name the four age bands the 86-module registry is organised into.
audience: Learners, educators, and anyone asking what is actually built
accessible_text: The curriculum pathway moves from Institute through Programme, Course, Module and Lesson, then down to Practice, Assessment, Mastery and Certification. The registry holds 86 modules across four age bands: Junior A for ages 6 to 8, Junior B for ages 9 to 10, Core for ages 11 to 16, and Advanced for ages 16 to 18.
